messages:
marta: Quick status check — Optimize toolkit delivery: sharing milestone owners + open blockers. TL;DR: quant recommendations PR in review, batching/caching experiment in staging, and an embedding regression alert landed from last night's canary. @kevin are you the model-owner for 7.3?

kevin: Yep, I'm owner for 7.3. Saw the regression alert in the dashboard. Do we have repro steps or a failing eval?

samir: Repro steps: run `evalset: optimize-regtest-v2` on staging using `quant=8bit-profile-C` + `kv-cache=enabled`. Observed ~3% top1 drop for short prompts (<=64 tokens). Quick log snippet: `2027-06-12T02:14:11Z ERROR logits: NaN detected after logit_scaling step` — happens ~1/5000 requests.

marta: Thanks. @rebecca can you triage perf vs quality? If quant profile C is the cause we can consider reverting that profile while keeping other changes.

rebecca: On it. Note: PR #4202 currently bundles profile-C + KV cache micro-optimizations. I suspect the cache path change could interact with scaling. I'll split the PR into `quant-profile-only` and `kv-cache-fix` so we can isolate. If we revert profile C only we may still see the issue.

kevin: I paused the canary rollout locally. Pinged eng-releases to hold 7.3 canary. @devbot do we have any auto-rollback hooks that might trigger?

devbot: deploy-bot: Canary for `release/7.3` paused by @kevin at 1795005000. Auto-rollback threshold remains at default: 1.5% embed drift. Manual intervention required to change threshold.

jia: For batching/caching experiments: `cache-prefix-v2` on staging reduces median latency ~12% but ups memory pressure by ~18%. Suggest enabling `adaptive-batching` on Dedicated for the next test to smooth latency without blowing memory. I can run a limited job on `ded-ml-2` this afternoon.

samir: Action items: (1) rebecca split PR and produce a `quant-only` revert candidate; (2) jia run ded test with adaptive-batching + cache-prefix-v2; (3) kevin keep canary paused and coordinate release ticket; (4) marta handle any customer comms if we end up rolling back. ETA for triage: EOD PST. Any objections?

rebecca: No objections. I'll push the PR split and a targeted unit/integration test for KV cache edge-cases by 1795005200. The tests will include a synthetic sequence that previously triggered NaN in scaling.

kevin: I'll update the release ticket and add a note for support to delay enterprise notifications until we have a safe path.

marta: Thanks all. I'll schedule a 15m sync at 11:30 PT if triage needs a fast handoff. If anyone finds a one-line revert that's safe, drop it here. Also include any benchmark numbers in the thread (latency, embed drift, mem). :thumbsup:

support-bot: support: Enterprise notifications for release/7.3 are paused per @kevin. Will resume when release ticket is updated.
